PhD Candidate in Astrophysics · Caltech

Kritti Sharma

I study how fast radio bursts and radio polarization can reveal the hidden baryons of the Universe — connecting the physics of gas around galaxies to the growth of cosmic structure and the parameters of our cosmological model.
